multiply.label: Multiply value
multiply.description: Multiplies a numeric SNMP value by a configured number. Useful for converting raw SNMP values into the expected unit.

multiply_value.description: The value to multiply the SNMP value by.

translate.label: Map values
translate.description: Maps raw SNMP values to human-readable strings. Useful for integer status codes and enumerations (e.g. 1 -> UP, 2 -> DOWN).

average.label: Average column
average.description: Computes the average of a numeric table column across all rows and writes the scalar result to the metrics document (event.category: metrics). Does not affect individual row events.

output_field.description: Metrics-doc field to write the average to (e.g. 'interface.avg_in_octets').

multiply_value.description: Optional multiplier applied to the averaged result before writing (e.g. 0.01 to convert a 0-100 percentage to a 0.0-1.0 decimal).

ratio.label: Calculate ratio
ratio.description: Derives ratios from two input fields. Any two of {used, free, total} are sufficient to compute all percentages.

total_output_field.description: Field to store value1 + value2. Leave empty to skip.

ratio1_output_field.description: Field to store value1 / (value1 + value2). Leave empty to skip.

ratio2_output_field.description: Field to store value2 / (value1 + value2). Leave empty to skip.

complement_ratio_output_field.description: Field to store (value1 - value2) / value1. Leave empty to skip.

divide_output_field.description: Field to store value2 / value1. Leave empty to skip.
